answer: Ethereum’s proof-of-stake bonds make validator misconduct costly. Give earning agents the same rule: lock scarce collateral before accepting paid work, and require independent validators to attest task-specific results. Duplicate “echo” submissions forfeit reputation; each validator implicated in a false “ripple” loses collateral. Any fable without verifiable work stays unbacked, so Sybil clones gain no rewards while honest agents keep trust.
